title: When I opened the door
context_es: Tu profesora de inglés os ha pedido un relato corto para el blog de la clase.
prompt_en:
Your English teacher has asked you to write a story for the class blog. Your story must begin with this sentence:

When I opened the door, I couldn't believe what I saw.
points: say clearly what happened and how you felt
useful_language: It was the best / strangest day of my life.
tips_es: Mezcla tiempos del pasado: *past simple* para la acción, *past continuous* para el fondo y *past perfect* para lo anterior.
Los conectores de tiempo (*suddenly, a few minutes later, in the end*) hacen avanzar el relato.
Un buen relato tiene principio, problema y final: no lo dejes abierto.
model_answer:
When I opened the door, I couldn't believe what I saw. My whole living room was full of balloons, and twenty people were standing there in silence, smiling at me.

At first, I didn't understand anything. I had completely forgotten that it was my birthday, because I had been working late all week. Suddenly, everybody shouted "Surprise!" and my sister ran to hug me. She had flown from Dublin that morning without telling me.

While we were eating the cake, my best friend gave me a small box. Inside there was a train ticket to Lisbon, the city I had always wanted to visit. I was so happy that I started to cry.

In the end, we danced until two in the morning. It was the best birthday of my life, and I will never forget it.
